job.title: Staff Data Scientist
job.pay_full: $141,100 – $226,000 a year (US estimated salary range, may include potential sales incentive payments if applicable); may be eligible for bonus and equity

details.about: Visa is a world leader in payments technology, operating across more than 200 countries and territories. Its Post Purchase organization is building decision intelligence for dispute resolution and recovery products, including RDR, CDRN, VDRN and Recover. This Staff Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor who leads machine learning work that improves automation, recovery outcomes and client experience at global scale, using large-scale transaction and dispute data.
duties: Define and lead ML initiatives across dispute decisioning, merchant matching and recovery prediction
Own the full ML lifecycle: problem framing, feature engineering, model development, deployment and monitoring
Build and productionize scalable models on large transaction and dispute datasets
Partner with Product, Engineering and Data Engineering to turn business needs into data-driven solutions
Drive adoption through explainability, performance measurement and stakeholder alignment
Build experimentation frameworks to evaluate and keep improving model performance
Design GenAI/LLM-based solutions for explainability, workflow automation and decision support
Influence product strategy and mentor junior team members
needs: 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree, or at least 2 years with an advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD), or 0 years with a PhD, or 8+ years of relevant work experience
Digital fluency, including working with emerging technologies such as generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot)
nice: 6+ years of experience with a Bachelor's, 4+ years with an advanced degree, or up to 3 years with a PhD
Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in AI, Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research or a related quantitative field
A track record of putting analytical or ML solutions into production with measurable business outcomes
Experience leading end-to-end projects across cross-functional teams, with Agile experience
Large-scale datasets and distributed processing frameworks such as Hadoop, Hive and Spark
Python or R, SQL, and version control with git or GitHub
Experience in payments, fraud, risk, disputes, fintech or other transaction-heavy domains
details.benefits: Estimated US salary range $141,100 – $226,000 a year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable); the position may also be eligible for bonus and equity. Visa's benefits package, for which this position may be eligible, includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, life insurance, paid time off and a wellness program.
notes: Hybrid: Visa requires employees to work in the office 3 days a week
Full time; work hours vary with the needs of the department
